name: Tor'gan's Orb
summary: Tor'gan's Orb carries raptor essence to Gor'mul at Hammerfall. Tor'gan hopes its power will restore the old warrior's purpose.

sections.title: Raptor Essence
sections.body: At Hammerfall, Tor'gan gives you an orb charged with the power and spirit of raptors. He asks you to bring it to Gor'mul, hoping its energy will restore the warrior's spirit and give him new purpose.

faq.answer: Tor'gan's Orb carries raptor power and spirit, meant to give Gor'mul the essence of the raptor.
Tor'gan asks you to bring the orb to Gor'mul at Hammerfall.
Tor'gan provides the orb and charges it with raptor essence.

faq.q: Why does Gor'mul need the orb?
faq.answer: Tor'gan hopes the raptor essence will invigorate Gor'mul's spirit and give him new purpose.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry the orb to Gor'mul so he may learn the Horde's present state and lend his strength to its battles.
